preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: String s has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The length of string t is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(t) == m and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in t)
preconditions.description: String t has length m and consists only of lowercase English letters.
The maximum number of pieces x is between 1 and 30 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if min_pieces(s, t) <= x else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if the minimum number of non-intersecting substrings of s that concatenate to t in order is less than or equal to x, otherwise output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: min_pieces(s, t) == min(k for k in range(1, m + 1) if exists_valid_partition(s, t, k)) if any_valid_partition(s, t) else float('inf')
postconditions.description: The function min_pieces(s, t) represents the smallest integer k such that t can be formed by concatenating k non-intersecting substrings of s in their original relative order; if no such partition exists, it is infinity.
